name: zig-analyzer
description: Zig language support through the zig-analyzer language server

zig-analyzer.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `zig-analyzer` executable. Empty: looked up in `PATH`. A leading `~/` is the home directory. Takes effect after restarting the server.

zig-analyzer.server.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables of the server process. Takes effect after restarting the server.

zig-analyzer.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the messages between VS Code and the server to the `zig-analyzer` output channel.

zig-analyzer.zig.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `zig` executable. Default: looked up in `PATH`. It must be Zig 0.17.0 or 0.17.1; otherwise projects with `build.zig` are not loaded. Takes effect after restarting the server.

zig-analyzer.zig.lib_path.markdownDescription: Zig lib directory, which must contain `std/std.zig`; overrides what `zig env` reports. The standard library is read from it, and zig runs with `ZIG_LIB_DIR` set to it.

zig-analyzer.zig.global_cache_path.markdownDescription: Existing global cache directory; overrides what `zig env` reports. zig runs with `ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR` set to it.

zig-analyzer.zig.builtin_path.markdownDescription: `@import("builtin")` of files outside any project. Default: generated for the native target. Modules of a project always use the one of their build settings.

zig-analyzer.build.enable.markdownDescription: Load projects through the build system protocol (`zig build --listen=-`); off handles every file in single-file mode.

zig-analyzer.build.args.markdownDescription: Extra arguments passed to `zig build`, such as `-Dtarget=aarch64-linux`.

zig-analyzer.diagnostics.steps.markdownDescription: Build steps for compiler diagnostics. Empty: `check` if the project has it, otherwise the default step.

zig-analyzer.diagnostics.compiler.markdownDescription: Run the compiler on save for diagnostics; off gives only live diagnostics (syntax and AstGen) while typing.

zig-analyzer.diagnostics.inactive_code.markdownDescription: Mark code that is not compiled in the current build configuration (branches comptime knows are not taken) as inactive.

zig-analyzer.diagnostics.debounce_ms.markdownDescription: Milliseconds without edits before live diagnostics are computed; 0 for no delay.

zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.types.markdownDescription: Inferred types of local variables without a type annotation.

zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.field_types.markdownDescription: Field types after the field names in initializers that have a result type (`.{ .x: i32 = 1 }`).

zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.anonymous_conta.markdownDescription: Also show type hints whose type has an anonymous container, which is shown by its content.

zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.builtin_paramet.markdownDescription: Parameter names at builtin call arguments (`@memcpy(dest: a, source: b)`), for builtins whose arguments do not show what they are. Needs `#zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.parameters#`.

zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.exclude_single_.markdownDescription: No parameter names for calls with a single argument (including builtins and method calls like `list.append(item)`).

zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.hide_redundant_.markdownDescription: Hide the parameter name when the argument already has that name: a variable or a field access ending in it, also behind `&`, `.*`, `.?` and `try`.

zig-analyzer.inlay_hints.max_length.markdownDescription: Type hints longer than this many characters end with `…` instead of their remaining fields or arguments. 0 never truncates.

enumDescriptions: Only tokens whose class needs name resolution and types; keywords, comments, literals, operators, labels and built-in names are left to the syntax highlighting.

zig-analyzer.semantic_tokens.global_var.markdownDescription: Mark container-level `var` declarations and their references with the `global` modifier.

enumDescriptions: One line for each other instance, with its type, location, and the call it comes from.
The complete hover of each other instance (signature, value, documentation).
zig-analyzer.hover.instances.markdownDescription: In a generic function body, how hover shows the declarations a member name refers to under the other instances.

zig-analyzer.completion.auto_import.markdownDescription: In name completion, also offer reachable declarations and modules that are not imported yet, adding the import when one is accepted, and members of visible namespaces matched by their whole path (`memeql` -> `std.mem.eql`).

zig-analyzer.completion.max_auto_imports.markdownDescription: At most this many candidates besides the names in scope per completion (the list is marked incomplete and refreshed as you type); 0 never limits.

zig-analyzer.completion.snippets.markdownDescription: Functions and builtins complete as calls, and common snippets are offered where a statement or a declaration starts.

zig-analyzer.completion.argument_placeho.markdownDescription: Call snippets get a placeholder for each argument; off inserts only the parentheses, with the cursor between them.

enumDescriptions: Right after the import they come from.
In a last group of their own.
zig-analyzer.imports.derived.markdownDescription: Where declarations derived from an import (`const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator;`) go, in "Organize imports" and auto-import.

enumDescriptions: By what is imported: module name, file path with nearer files first, the full access path of derived declarations.
zig-analyzer.imports.sort.markdownDescription: Order of imports within a group.

zig-analyzer.sema.callsite_seeding.markdownDescription: Inside generic functions with no concrete types, infer with the instances from call sites (hover, completion, inlay hints, ...).

zig-analyzer.sema.wait_for_project.markdownDescription: Requests that use name resolution and types wait until the projects have loaded, so that every answer is complete. Off answers at once with what is known so far.

zig-analyzer.sema.max_intern_pool_mb.markdownDescription: Discard all cached type information when the intern pool exceeds this many MB and twice the most that one request has added; it is recomputed on demand. 0 never discards.

zig-analyzer.cache.capacity.markdownDescription: Syntax trees kept in memory. 0 keeps all.

zig-analyzer.cache.queries.markdownDescription: Per query: how many values (`count`) and how many MB (`mb`) are kept, taking precedence over `#zig-analyzer.cache.capacity#`. 0 removes the limit.

zig-analyzer.workspace_symbol.dependenci.markdownDescription: Also list symbols from dependencies (fetched packages, generated files, opened std files).

zig-analyzer.workspace_symbol.limit.markdownDescription: At most this many symbols per query (the best matches are kept); 0 never limits.

zig-analyzer.naming.enable.markdownDescription: Hint names that do not follow the Names section of the Zig style guide, with rename fixes. Only open files of your own code are checked.

zig-analyzer.naming.ignore.markdownDescription: Names the naming check skips; `*` matches any sequence of characters (`SDL_*`).

zig-analyzer.naming.exclude.markdownDescription: Files the naming check skips: `/`-separated paths relative to the workspace root; `*` matches any sequence of characters, including `/`.

zig-analyzer.naming.rules.markdownDescription: Turn individual naming rules on or off; each matches the diagnostic code `naming.<rule>`.

namespace.description: Namespaces (files with no top-level fields): snake_case.

field.description: Fields and enum members, by the type of the field.

enumDescriptions: The server watches files when the editor cannot register file watchers.
Always the server (the editor's notifications are still handled).

zig-analyzer.log.level.markdownDescription: Server log level. Logs appear in the `zig-analyzer` output channel.

zig-analyzer.log.file.markdownDescription: Also append server logs to this file.

zig-analyzer.log.slow_request_ms.markdownDescription: Log a breakdown of the queries for requests slower than this many milliseconds; 0 turns it off.

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p test && node out-test/test/run.js
